# cloudaxion_locations (Data Source)

Every CloudAxion location available to the account.

Location slugs are how resources are placed. There is no endpoint that lists resources across locations, so anything needing a global view must iterate over these.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# CloudAxion has no endpoint that lists resources across locations, so the
# location slug matters: every scoped resource lives in exactly one.
data "cloudaxion_locations" "all" {}

output "available_locations" {
  value = [for l in data.cloudaxion_locations.all.locations : l.slug]
}

output "default_location" {
  value = data.cloudaxion_locations.all.default_slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `default_slug` (String) Slug of the location marked as default. Requests that specify no location act on it.
- `locations` (Attributes List) All available locations, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:

- `country_code` (String) Country the location sits in.
- `description` (String) Description supplied by CloudAxion.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the account's default location.
- `is_preferred` (Boolean) Whether CloudAxion marks this location as preferred.
- `slug` (String) Identifier used in location-scoped API paths and in the provider's `location`.
